command:
ls -l cleaned.csv && python3 - <<'EOF'
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open("cleaned.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8")))
names = [r["name"] for r in rows]
print(f"rows: {len(rows)}")
print(f"names: {', '.join(names)}")
assert all(int(r["age"]) >= 25 for r in rows), "found a row with age < 25"
print("rule check passed: every row has age >= 25")
EOF
